# Lines, levels, terminators, xrefs, continuations and the header/trailer frame.
#
# Format: `### ID | C|L | purpose (origin)`, then the GEDCOM input, then directives:
#   #want LINE    the written output contains this line
#   #model TEXT   the parsed model keeps this text (newline written \n)
#   #lacks TEXT   the written output does not contain this text
#   #target VERS  write as 5.5.1, 7.0 or 7.1 instead of the input's version
# Tokens: <CR> / <CRLF> end a line with that terminator, <NOEOL> ends the input without one,
# <TAB>, <BOM> and <U+XXXX> stand for those characters. Every name, place and value is fictitious.

### G7-EOL-CR | C | CR-only line endings (python test_line_terminators, gramps imp_*_CR, gedcom4j utf8_cr_nobom)
0 HEAD<CR>
1 GEDC<CR>
2 VERS 7.0<CR>
0 @I1@ INDI<CR>
1 SEX M<CR>
0 TRLR<CR>
#want 1 SEX M

### G7-EOL-CRLF | C | CRLF line endings
0 HEAD<CRLF>
1 GEDC<CRLF>
2 VERS 7.0<CRLF>
0 @I1@ INDI<CRLF>
1 SEX M<CRLF>
0 TRLR<CRLF>
#want 1 SEX M

### G7-BOM | C | leading U+FEFF ignored
<BOM>0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 SEX F
0 TRLR
#want 1 SEX F

### G7-NOEOL | L | last line without terminator
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 SEX F
0 TRLR<NOEOL>
#want 1 SEX F

### G7-TAB-ASTRAL | C | tab and astral chars kept in payload
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NOTE ok<TAB>here 😀
0 TRLR
#want 1 NOTE ok	here 😀

### G7-BANNED-C0 | L | banned control char in payload: lenient keep (L), writer must not emit it raw
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NOTE bad<U+0007>char
0 TRLR

### G7-LEVEL-LEADING-ZERO | L | '01 NAME' leading zero level
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
01 NAME John /Doe/
0 TRLR
#want 1 NAME John /Doe/

### G7-LEADING-SPACE | L | indented lines (L; legal in 5.5.1, banned in 7.0; gedcom4j Issue166, Armidale ValidateSpacing)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
  1 NAME John /Doe/
0 TRLR
#want 1 NAME John /Doe/

### G7-DOUBLE-SPACE-BEFORE-TAG | L | '1  NAME' extra delimiter
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1  NAME John /Doe/
0 TRLR
#want 1 NAME John /Doe/

### G7-LOWERCASE-TAG | L | lower-case tag kept as-is
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 _x lower
0 TRLR
#want 1 _x lower

### G7-BLANK-LINE | L | blank line between lines (L; gedcom4j Issue64)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI

1 SEX M
0 TRLR
#want 1 SEX M

### G7-TWO-SPACES-PAYLOAD | C | second space after tag belongs to payload
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NOTE  leading space kept
0 TRLR
#want 1 NOTE  leading space kept

### G7-TRAILING-SPACE | C | trailing payload space preserved
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NOTE trailing 
0 TRLR
#want 1 NOTE trailing 

### G7-AT-LEADING | C | leading @@ decoded, re-escaped on write
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NOTE me@example.com is my email
2 CONT @@me and @I are handles
0 TRLR
#want 2 CONT @@me and @I are handles

### G7-AT-ONLY-FIRST | C | @@@@@ decodes to @@@@ (only leading pair)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @N1@ SNOTE @@@@@ has four
0 TRLR
#want 0 @N1@ SNOTE @@@@@ has four

### G7-LEVEL-SKIP | L | level jump 0->2 (L; python test_level_may_not_skip, gedcom4j Issue87)

2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
2 _FOO bar
1 SEX M
0 TRLR
#want 1 SEX M

### G7-DEEP-NESTING | C | levels beyond 9 (python test_deep_nesting, gedcom4j issue102)
0 HEAD
1 GEDC

4 _L4
5 _L5
6 _L6
7 _L7
8 _L8
9 _L9
10 _L10

### G7-VOIDPTR | C | @VOID@ pointers kept
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI

1 FAMC @VOID@
0 TRLR
#want 1 FAMC @VOID@
#want 1 ALIA @I1@

#want 1 FAMS @F9@

0 TRLR

### G7-DUP-XREF | L | duplicate xref (L): both records kept, writer must emit unique xrefs
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 SEX M
0 @I1@ INDI
1 SEX F
0 TRLR
#want 1 SEX M
#want 1 SEX F

0 TRLR
#want 1 NOTE hi

### G7-CONT-BLANK | C | blank CONT lines
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NOTE This is a note field that
2 CONT   spans four lines.
2 CONT
2 CONT (the third line was blank)
0 TRLR
#want 2 CONT   spans four lines.
#want 2 CONT (the third line was blank)

### G7-CONC-IN-7 | L | CONC in a 7.0 file (L; removed in 7.0) - writer must not emit CONC in 7.0
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NOTE abc
2 CONC def
0 TRLR
#want 1 NOTE abcdef
#lacks CONC

### G7-CONT-AFTER-SUB | L | CONT after another substructure
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NOTE a
2 LANG en
2 CONT b
0 TRLR

0 TRLR

### G7-NO-HEAD | L | missing HEAD

### G7-TRLR-SUB | L | TRLR with substructure
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 TRLR
1 NOTE nope

### G7-EMPTY | L | empty input: must not panic (Ok(empty) or Err both acceptable)

### X-CUSTOM-AFTER-PTR-CITATION | C | custom tag directly after pointer citation (gramps imp_FTM_LINK shape)
0 HEAD
1 SOUR EXAMPLE_APP
1 SUBM @U0@
1 GEDC
2 VERS 5.5.1
2 FORM LINEAGE-LINKED
1 CHAR UTF-8
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NAME Ann /Example/
2 SOUR @S1@
3 _LINK https://example.org/record/1
0 @S1@ SOUR
1 TITL S
0 @U0@ SUBM
1 NAME Example Submitter
0 TRLR
#want 3 _LINK https://example.org/record/1

### X-DUP-XREF-UNIQUE | L | duplicate xref: output xrefs must be unique
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 SEX M
0 @I1@ INDI
1 SEX F
0 TRLR
#lacks @I1@ INDI
#want 1 SEX F

### X-BANNED-OUT | L | banned char must not be written raw
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 NOTE bad<U+0007>char
0 TRLR
#lacks <U+0007>

### X-NEWLINE-IN-PAYLOAD-551 | C | CONT in 5.5.1 written back as CONT
0 HEAD
1 SOUR EXAMPLE_APP
1 SUBM @U0@
1 GEDC
2 VERS 5.5.1
2 FORM LINEAGE-LINKED
1 CHAR UTF-8
0 @U1@ SUBM
1 NAME Sub
1 NOTE a
2 CONT b
0 @U0@ SUBM
1 NAME Example Submitter
0 TRLR
#want 2 CONT b

### X-LEVEL-JUMP-NO-REPARENT | L | level jump after new record must not attach to previous record
0 HEAD
1 GEDC
2 VERS 7.0
0 @I1@ INDI
1 BIRT
2 DATE 1 JAN 2000
0 @I2@ INDI
2 _FOO bar
1 SEX F
0 TRLR
#want 1 SEX F
